name: vkQuake2 Vita
author: DrDecki
description:
vkQuake2 is a port of Quake II for the PS Vita based on vkQuake2 by Krzysztof Kondrak. It runs the game's original Vulkan renderer and SPIR-V shaders on the Vita through VkVita, a Vulkan implementation on top of GXM.
The port supports the full single player campaign, deathmatch over Wi-Fi against Vita and PC players, sound effects and the ogg soundtrack. It runs at 960x544 with 2x MSAA and reaches 60 FPS in most areas.
The port was made mainly as a test case for VkVita, a vibecoded Vulkan layer, and not as a replacement for the existing Quake II port.
